Breastfeeding Week celebrated at MGIMS
Wednesday, 23 August 2017
6828 Hits
August 2017. Students’ wing of MGIMS Bioethics Unit celebrated Breastfeeding Week in the premises from 17
th
to 23
rd
August 2107. Keeping in mind the Article 14 of Universal Declaration on Bioethics and Human Rights: UNESCO which states Social Responsibility of a medical person, the students took up the oppurtunity to educate on the cause. They approached the lactating mothers and made them aware regarding various important aspects of breastfeeding like proper technique, positioning, signs of attachments, benefits of breastfeeding, disadvantages of artificial feeding and bottles, harmful misconceptions, etc.
Students from Bioethics Unit - Akshay Yadav, Anik Pal, Sarang Bombatkar, Mudita Joshi, Hemavaishnave T S, Shreya Namjoshi, Ajay Kedar, Ananta Zanwar, Prachi Kamble, Simran Raka, Sakshi Chandak, Sujay Srivastava, Atharva Kokaje, Cheryl Mankar, Mehul Dhabaliya and Mimansa Dixit - participated in the Breastfeeding Week celebration.
The students’ wing divided themselves in 8 pairs and covered the antenatal and postnatal wards in MCH building on alternate days. The students approached the lactating mother with pictorial charts depicting the correct techniques of breastfeeding. They also narrated a story of a neonate who lost his life due to improper method of breastfeeding. The demonstration did help the mothers learn the right way of latching and they seemed keen to practice it.
The students were extremely elated when one of the mothers approached them and said, “Main apki khub aabhari hun... Mera tarika galat tha aur agar aaj apne muje bataya nahi hota toh mera bachhe ko iske dushparinaam jhelna padte... Jaari rakhiye is nek kaam ko.”
Mr Akshay Yadav (President, Students’ Wing, MGIMS Bioethics Unit) expressed his profound satisfaction when the students were widely acclaimed and invited to address the population in nearby villages. He exclaimed,” We couldn’t be happier. It is like adding more feathers to the success cap of Bioethics Unit.”
Mr Anik Pal (Vice- President, Students' Wing, MGIMS Bioethics Unit) said, “The overwhelming success of the breastfeeding week would eventually make us plan more of such events in future.”
The entire Bioethics students’ wing expressed their gratitude towards Dr S Yelwatkar (Head, MGIMS Bioethics UNIT, The UNESCO Chair in BIOETHICS, Haifa and Associate Professor, Dept of Medicine), Dr J Waghmare (Associate Professor, Dept of Anatomy), Dr N Bansod (Associate Professor, Dept of Physiology) and Dr L Chimurkar (Assistant Professor, Dept of Pharmacology), for helping the students coordinate the event and supporting it through out.
Dr P Shivkumar (Head, Dept of Obstetrics and Gynaecology) and Dr M Jain (Head, Dept of Paediatrics) were deeply acknowledged for their guidance and help.
Swachhata Pakhwada April 2024
